title: Proportional editing

initial.text: With Proportional Editing on, moving one point drags its neighbours along, less and less with distance, like pulling up a cloth.

steps.text: Add ▸ Mesh ▸ Grid: a flat sheet made of many small squares.
And Y Subdivisions to 16: more points make a smoother hill.
Click the vertex in the middle.
Turn on Proportional Editing, the circle icon in the header.
Mesh ▸ Transform ▸ Move it up on Z. The neighbours follow, the closer the more.
Set Proportional Size to 0.6 m: only points within that distance follow, so the hill gets narrower.

outro: Proportional Editing turns one point into a smooth hill. O toggles it.
